summary: Verified P0 batch: replenishment sort (POS asc + bin natural asc, empties last), Footfall Exploration table, Launch Date columns + Whole-year filter on SOR L-10 / SOR All Styles / Exports SOR Report, and long-name wrapping across Replenishments / Products / Exports SOR. All 6 features pass.

minor.issue: POS ASC sort is case-sensitive (ASCII), so 'Vivo MSA Digo Road' (uppercase MSA) sorts before 'Vivo Mama Ngina St' (lowercase 'ama'). All other rows are correctly sorted. If a true natural alpha sort is desired, use case-insensitive comparison on pos_location in _sort_key.

action_items: Optional: make POS ASC sort case-insensitive in analytics_replenishment_report so 'Vivo Mama Ngina St' precedes 'Vivo MSA Digo Road' (currently uppercase letters beat lowercase).

Documentation nit: the review request listed the SOR L-10 launch-month filter testid as 'sor-new-styles-l10-table-launch-month-filter' but the actual rendered testid is 'l10-table-launch-month-filter'. Either rename to match the spec or update the spec/docs so downstream tests don't break.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend _bin_natural / _sort_key in server.py correctly mixes alpha + numeric chunks (AD52<AD61, E20<E126), with empty bins pushed last per POS — confirmed across multiple date windows.

Frontend wrapping is implemented uniformly via white-space:normal + word-break — verified via getComputedStyle on Replenishments, SOR L-10, SOR All Styles, Exports SOR Report and Catalog tables. No CSS line-clamp remnants on the touched columns.

LaunchMonthFilter '__YEAR__:' sentinel approach works: 'Whole year 2026' option appears in L-10 (only year in that 3-4-month window) and both 'Whole year 2025' + 'Whole year 2026' appear in SOR All Styles.

Footfall Exploration table uses immediate-prior period to populate 'Footfall In (last period)' regardless of compareMode — verified with compareMode=None defaults; non-zero values shown for all 27 stores.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 P0 features verified working on https://bi-platform-2.preview.emergentagent.com. Key testids confirmed live: ff-exploration-table, ff-exploration, sor-all-styles-table-launch-month-filter, l10-table-launch-month-filter (NOTE: not 'sor-new-styles-l10-...' as the review request stated). Backend replenishment sort verified on 2026-04-01..15 and 2026-03-01..15 — both pass POS-asc + bin-natural-asc + empty-last invariants (Vivo Acacia rows AD52→AD61→B126→C37→C96→D80→E20→E126 confirms numeric-aware comparison). Only minor: pos_location sort is case-sensitive, not a blocker.
rca of the issue: n/a — no bugs reproduced. Only minor case-sensitivity nuance in POS ASC sort noted above.
